records.title: Wall Street closes sharply lower as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
records.summary: The Guardian reports that on October 30 the Nasdaq fell 2.84%, the S&P 500 fell 1.80% and the Dow fell 1.09%, with technology shares pressured by Intel and Amazon results and concerns about AI spending. This is broad macro/risk-off context for XRP event attribution, not evidence that the Binance incident caused XRP's move.
records.limitations: Daily index moves and a live-blog narrative do not isolate the causal effect of the Binance incident on XRP. No event-study controls or intraday synchronized returns are supplied.
